propositions: rebar truncates DC comments at hardcoded 32767 chars but Jira DC's jira.text.field.character.limit is admin-configurable with range 0-2147483647, causing silent data loss when an admin raises or removes the limit
the default 32767 is correct for stock Jira 7.0+ and must not change, but operators with raised limits need configurability to prevent truncation of comments Jira would accept
sanitize_comment and fit_comment must no longer share the description fitter (fit_outbound) to prevent future description-fitter changes from silently retargeting the comment path
comment_max_chars must be a configurable parameter on ReconcilerConfig defaulting to 32767 with documented provenance from jira.text.field.character.limit and JRASERVER-28519
the endpoint /rest/api/2/application-properties is admin-only and unreadable by rebar's ordinary-user PAT, so auto-discovery is not viable and configuration is the sole remedy
